scientific_integrity.method: Closed finite-dimensional Fourier proof with analytic character sums; independent numerical matrix and modular cross-checks.
scientific_integrity.uncertainty: Originality provisional against inaccessible or unindexed literature; independent external validation absent.

scientific_limitations: Uniform magnitude nearest-neighbor hopping and uniform site energies are essential; random hopping strengths, disorder, additional dephasing and interactions are not covered.
The theorem is an infinite-time statement for fixed finite rings; no uniform rate of approach to the limit is claimed.
Known periodic-trap zero-flux results and general spectral dark-state mechanisms are recognized as prior art.
title: Arithmetic flux switching of dark states on lossy quantum rings
